text:
Type: large dark grey industrial pendant lamp
Use: strong directed light over a dining table or a kitchen island; dining room, kitchen, living room
Style: industrial, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: matte powder-coated steel shade with a light inner surface, black cord woven through a metal chain, steel ceiling plate
Colors: dark charcoal grey, warm white inside
Shape: wide bell shade with a straight cylindrical crown and a broad flared rim, hangs from a link chain, oversized and bold, heavy visual weight
Feel: bold, urban, grounded, moody
Goes with: long wooden tables, concrete, black metal chairs; industrial lofts, modern kitchens

product.name: HEKTAR
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 600 lumen globe opal white. View more product information This lamp gives a pleasant light for dining and spreads a good directed light across your dining or bar table.
